title_en: Call for Applications: Fall 2026 SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Scholarship (Reminder)
summary: International students in Seoul National University regular graduate programs who meet all of the eligibility conditions may apply for the Fall 2026 SNU Global EDGE Fellowship. The fellowship covers full tuition and a monthly living allowance of 1,800,000 KRW through Spring 2027. Applicants must prepare the required documents listed in the attachments and submit them by email by Thursday, 15 October 2026; the email address is given in the original notice.
applies_to: Optional (application-based) scholarship. An applicant must meet all of the following at the same time: (1) be enrolled in a regular graduate program at Seoul National University in Fall 2026, excluding students expected to complete coursework (수료) in Spring 2027 and excluding students on leave of absence; (2) be an international (foreign) student in a department in which a BK21 Stage 4 education and research group (team) has been established; (3) be, as of Fall 2026, an international student in a graduate school participating in the BK21 Stage 4 program who is not receiving a scholarship from the research group. Five students will be selected.

dates.what: Deadline to submit application documents by email (all applicants)
Living allowance for selected students is paid retroactively from this month
End of the scholarship benefit period; the program and payments run only until this semester
dates.when: Until Spring semester of the 2027 academic year

conditions: All three eligibility conditions must be met at the same time.
Students expected to complete coursework (수료) in Spring 2027 are not eligible.
Students on leave of absence cannot apply.
Students who already receive a scholarship from a BK21 research group are not eligible.

The list of eligible departments is in an attachment and may change following the National Research Foundation of Korea re-review schedule; any change will be announced in advance in cooperation with the relevant graduate school.
The fellowship cannot be combined with other scholarships, including tuition-waiver scholarships and other BK21-related research scholarships.
Because selection takes place in November, tuition already paid by a selected student will be refunded, and the living allowance will be paid retroactively from September.
Recipients must keep their status as BK21 participating graduate students throughout the benefit period.
Scholarship payments end with Spring 2027 because the program runs only until that semester.
Required documents and other important notes are given only in the attachments, which were not read for this translation.
steps: Read the attachments, including the selection plan and the Guidelines for SNU Global EDGE Scholarship for Fall 2026, and check the BK21 Stage 4 research group list (Attachment 3) to confirm that your department is eligible; the contents of the attachments were not read for this translation.

Complete the required documents provided as attachments, such as the application form (SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Application form_Fall 2026), the BK21 participating graduate student confirmation form (BK참여 대학원생 확인서) and the recommendation letter form (SNU Global EDGE Fellowship 추천서 양식), as specified in the guidelines.
Submit the completed documents by email by Thursday, 15 October 2026, to the email address given in the original notice.
translation:
2026 Fall Semester SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program: Call for Scholarship Applicants (Reminder)

A. Eligibility (all of the following must be met at the same time)
① A student enrolled in a regular graduate program at Seoul National University in the Fall 2026 semester.
※ Students expected to complete coursework (수료) in Spring 2027 are excluded.
※ Students on leave of absence may not apply.
② An international student belonging to a department (or school) in which a BK21 Stage 4 education and research group (team) has been established.
※ See the attachment <Status of BK21 Stage 4 Selected Education and Research Groups (Teams) (Draft)>. (If the list changes according to the National Research Foundation of Korea re-review schedule, this will be announced in advance in cooperation with the relevant graduate school.)
③ As of Fall 2026, among international students in graduate schools participating in the BK21 Stage 4 program, a graduate student who is not receiving a research group scholarship.

B. Support: full tuition and a living allowance of 1,800,000 KRW per month (cannot be combined* with other scholarships).
* Cannot be combined with tuition-waiver scholarships or other BK21-related research scholarships.
※ Because selection for Fall 2026 takes place in November, tuition already paid by a selected student will be refunded, and the living allowance will be paid retroactively from September.

C. Scholarship period: until Spring semester of the 2027 academic year.
※ Recipients must maintain their status as BK21 participating graduate students throughout the benefit period.
※ As this program runs until Spring 2027, the scholarship will be paid only until Spring 2027.

D. Number to be selected: 5

E. How to apply
- Applicants from each college (graduate school) must complete the required documents and submit them by email by Thursday, 15 October 2026 (26.10.15.(목)). The email address is given in the original notice.

F. Required documents and other notes: see attachments.

Attachments (7) (their contents were not read for this translation):
(Attachment 1) 2026 Fall SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Selection Plan (PDF)
(Attachment 1) Guidelines for SNU Global EDGE Scholarship for Fall 2026 (PDF)
(Attachment 2) BK21 Participating Graduate Student Confirmation (form) [BK참여 대학원생 확인서(서식)] (HWP)
(Attachment 2) SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Program Application form_Fall 2026 (DOCX)
(Attachment 2) SNU Global EDGE Fellowship Recommendation Letter Form [SNU Global EDGE Fellowship 추천서 양식] (HWP)
(Attachment 3) Status of BK21 Stage 4 Education and Research Groups (Teams) (as of 2026.3.2.) (XLSX)
(Attachment 4) List of Applicants for the Fall 2026 Global EDGE Fellowship [2026학년도 2학기 Global EDGE Fellowship 지원자 명단] (XLSX)
